title: Technical Engineer - Process Intelligence
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
 Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
   

  

 For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
   

  

 © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Design, configure, test, and continuously improve enterprise process intelligence solutions and business process monitoring capabilities using Celonis EMS and related enterprise technologies.
   

  

 Support business transformation initiatives through IT changes, Agile DevOps delivery, and process optimization activities in line with global Information Technology (IT), enterprise architecture, and security standards to enable operational excellence, process transparency, and measurable business value.
   

  

 The role contributes to data\-driven decision making by translating business process requirements into scalable process mining solutions, dashboards, analytics, and actionable insights across global business functions.
   

  

* The Technical Engineer in IT Operations is responsible for translating business process requirements into detailed functional designs, Celonis stories, KPIs, dashboards, and EMS configurations in accordance with enterprise architecture and security standards. Working within projects, operational changes, and Agile DevOps teams, the Functional Engineer coordinates the preparation, review, execution, and testing of process mining solutions while ensuring high\-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment throughout the implementation lifecycle.


 The Technical Engineer actively collaborates with business process owners, implementation partners, and external consultants during the execution of enhancements and deployments. The role contributes to incident resolution, root cause analysis, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen operational performance and process transparency.
   

  

* The Functional Engineer in Application Delivery is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide process intelligence initiatives and defining scalable process mining solutions across business domains. The role drives strategic transformation programs, establishes governance standards, mentors team members, and partners with Architects and senior stakeholders to design advanced analytics, AI\-enabled process intelligence capabilities, and sustainable optimization roadmaps.


 The Functional Engineer oversees large\-scale implementations and complex operational changes together with strategic partners and cross\-functional teams. The role ensures quality execution, monitors delivery progress, governs testing and deployment activities, and leads continuous improvement, incident management, and process mining best practice adoption across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Functional Engineer with a strong background in process mining and a proven track record in designing \& implementing impactful process mining use cases. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in using Celonis to analyse, optimize, and transform key business operations, particularly within finance and supply chain functions.
   

  

 You will leverage Celonis Process Intelligence capabilities, AI\-driven insights, and Agentic Automation features to drive digital transformation initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, opportunities for potential savings, and developing advanced Celonis applications, dashboards, and intelligent workflows that enhance performance and achieve business objectives.
   

  

 The role will also contribute to the adoption of AI\-powered process optimization, predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and autonomous action orchestration across enterprise processes
   

  

**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
 Translate business process requirements into clear and detailed Celonis solution designs. Own and develop high\-quality stories and configuration specifications for Engineers, Developers, and implementation partners to translate into dashboards, process models, integrations, analytics, and EMS configurations including implementation proposals and deployment planning.
   

  

**Development \& delivery**
 Guide, coordinate, and oversee the preparation, implementation, and deployment of process intelligence solutions and related configurations. Ensure that all internal and external partners follow established standards including process documentation, governance controls, testing procedures, naming conventions, and architectural principles. Review, approve, and control the implementation of new enhancements, dashboards, KPIs, analytics models, and process mining capabilities across enterprise solutions.
   

  

 This results in sustainable, scalable, and business\-aligned solutions delivered in close collaboration with stakeholders, business process owners, and external service providers. Solutions are developed according to enterprise architecture and security standards, while changes are properly prepared, documented, validated, and implemented to deliver operational insights and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Testing**
 Own and coordinate testing activities for Celonis stories, dashboards, process models, and integrations. Develop and maintain test scenarios, review test outcomes, support user acceptance testing, coordinate business sign\-off, and contribute to release planning and test management activities to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments.
   

  

**Incident management**
 Perform functional and technical analysis of incidents, data quality issues, and process intelligence disruptions based on business impact and severity. Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and oversee deployment of fixes to ensure timely and effective issue resolution and stable operational performance.
   

  

**Process management and improvement**
 Monitor and analyze the performance, adoption, and security of Celonis solutions and related enterprise applications against agreed service and business KPIs. Actively contribute to process optimization initiatives through dashboard development, operational insight visualization, automation, and advanced analytics. Maintain visibility of technical debt and collaborate closely with Domain Architects and delivery teams to continuously improve process intelligence capabilities, DevOps practices, and platform stability.
   

  

**Project support**
 Support project and program managers by taking ownership of process intelligence deliverables including requirements gathering, configurations, dashboards, analytics, testing, and deployment coordination. Define, plan, manage, and execute assigned activities in alignment with IT delivery leads and business stakeholders to ensure efficient realization of project objectives and transformation outcomes.
   

  

**Experience**
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in process mining, analytics, business applications, or IT delivery
* Relevant Bachelor or Master degree
* Understands core Celonis EMS concepts, process mining fundamentals, and assigned enterprise applications within a defined business process area.
* Participates as a member of a project or Agile DevOps team supporting operational enhancements and low\-complexity changes with limited business impact.
* Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and LLM API integration. Knowledge of AI agents, tool/function calling, multi\-step workflows and agent orchestration. Good SQL skills and understanding of relational data, data models and business data. Ability to consume/build APIs and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications.
* Performs business and process analysis within a defined process mining scope and contributes to solution design activities.
* Identifies operational bottlenecks, process deviations, and compliance issues within assigned workflows.
* Supports story development, testing, configuration, and deployments with limited business complexity and operational risk.
* Provides internal support and advice regarding Celonis functionality, integrations, and operational issues.

title: Data Quality Analyst - Senior 2
description:
**Job Summary**
 Leads, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion and organizational improved capability to data quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Leads the quality and integrity of the data within the assigned functional area. Serves as an expert on data quality tools. Conducts data profiling for data. Develops Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure data quality. Creates and executes action plans to resolve data quality issues. Maintains existing rules and develops new rules to support a robust data quality process. Escalates issues and critical conflicts in a timely fashion. Identifies and mitigates data quality risks. Reports data quality risks and KPI measurement statistics to data governance council. Manages metadata and data standards to ensure adherence, working closely with IT. Coordinates activities of data stewards located within the business, working closely with the business process owner. Supports business data analysis and proposal creation as a member of a data governance council. Guides the business to prepare data. Leads initial data exploration steps (binning, pivoting, summarizing and finding correlations, for example). Catalogues business attributes to enable data discovery. Coaches business to establish and enforce guidelines for data collection, integration and processes. Leads data and systems analysis as required to support data governance processes. Understands data governance roles and processes, and ensures that they are followed. Prepares and presents communications to leaders and stakeholders.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Balances stakeholders \- Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Interpersonal savvy \- Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
   

  

 Manages ambiguity \- Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
   

  

 Data Analytics \- Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
   

  

 Data Mining \- Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.
   

  

 Data Modeling \- Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Data Communication and Visualization \- Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.
   

  

 Data Governance \- Assures definition, ownership, metadata management, and security for Cummins data.
   

  

 Data Literacy \- Expresses data in context, including data sources and constructs, analytical methods and applied techniques; describes the use\-case application and resulting value.
   

  

 Data Profiling \- Assesses data issues and cleansing requirements to perform data extraction, mapping, collection, and testing; establishes good, quality data.
   

  

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in statistics, information systems or related field required.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**
* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of the Enterprise Data Quality Framework across the data ecosystem(ingestion pipelines, data warehouses, semantic layers, and Data Products). Establish scalable standards, policies, controls, and best practices that ensure enterprise data is trusted, governed, certified, and AI\-ready. 2\) Establish and operationalize data quality capabilities by implementing automated data profiling, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, observability, issue management, and scorecard processes. Define measurable data quality KPIs, SLAs, and governance mechanisms that improve the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and reliability of critical enterprise data assets. 3\) Partner with Data Engineering, Solution Engineering, Enterprise Data Management (EDM), Architecture, Product Management, cross functional teams and Business teams to embed Data\-as\-a\-Product quality practices throughout the data lifecycle, including business rule management, metadata standards, lineage validation, certification processes, root cause analysis, and proactive remediation of data quality issues.


**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and leading enterprise Data Quality programs and frameworks, including data profiling, validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis, monitoring, issue management, scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives across large\-scale Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Product environments. 2\) Strong expertise in Data Quality, Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management (MDM), Business Glossary Management, and Data\-as\-a\-Product practices, with experience establishing quality standards, controls, certification processes, and governance frameworks for enterprise data assets. 3\) Proven experience implementing and automating data quality controls across the end\-to\-end data lifecycle, including Source Systems, Data Ingestion, Raw/Bronze, Curated/Silver, Business/Gold, Semantic Models, and Enterprise Data Products, utilizing capabilities such as data profiling, rule\-based validations, reconciliations, anomaly detection, exception management, data observability, and quality KPI monitoring. 4\) Hands\-on expertise with modern cloud data platforms and data engineering technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks, SQL, Matillion, dbt, and Power BI, with the ability to design scalable data quality solutions and embed quality controls within enterprise data pipelines. 5\) Experience with enterprise Data Quality and Governance platforms, and data observability solutions to implement data quality frameworks, metadata management, lineage, cataloging, certification, and governance capabilities across enterprise data products.

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

****About Maritime****
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 DNV is the world’s largest ship classification society with a global presence. DNV is a self\-owned foundation, with the purpose of safeguarding life, property, and the environment. DNV has high ambitions for improving business processes and services by using AI. DNV is now establishing an AI team in Pune to strengthen DNV’s ability to meet ambitious business goals.
   

  

 You will be part of a leading AI competency and development team located at the two locations Pune and Oslo (DNV headquarters). The AI team focuses on use of AI and machine learning to improve DNV’s maritime global work processes. We create AI systems that enable and support digitalization of DNV’s global production processes and systems as well as creation of new digital services. The AI team consists of experienced data scientists and software developers. You will collaborate in teams with different functional competencies and domain experts. Our deliveries have a global impact through our multi\-national organization, and through cooperation with large companies.
   

  

****Daily Tasks / Duties:****
 You will solve real\-world business cases and be a key contributor to programming and releasing AI and Machine Learning solutions. You will engage in all project phases, from dialogue with stakeholders to understand the problem to be solved, through data analysis, planning technical architecture and team collaboration on experimenting, programming and releasing solutions through our DevOps cycles to production. You are also expected to actively explore new opportunities for applied AI, to stay up\-to\-dated with main trends in the AI industry, and to identify how AI may create new business opportunities for DNV.
   

  

 What we offer

title: Historical Market Data (HMD)
description:
**Why Mizuho** 




  





 At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone
 



  





 It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



  





 The Historical Market Data (HMD) team is a specialist function within Enterprise Risk responsible for the quality, completeness, and controlled implementation of market risk time series used in Value at Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR), stress testing, and related risk and capital calculations.
 



 Reporting to the Head of Risk Appetite and Capital Analysis, the candidate will own front\-to\-back onboarding and maintenance of historical risk\-factor data across spot, curves, spreads, and volatility surfaces. The role requires strong understanding of market risk time\-series construction, returns and shock generation, proxy and backfill methodologies, data\-quality controls, and the downstream impact of data changes on risk measures. The successful candidate will work closely with Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  




* Lead front\-to\-back onboarding of historical market data and risk\-factor time series, including spot, curve, spread, and volatility surface data.
* Manage time\-series implementations end to end, covering requirements analysis, data sourcing, mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and production delivery.
* Assess the suitability and completeness of market data used in VaR, SVaR, stress testing, FRTB, and related capital calculations.
* Perform data\-quality analysis across completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, outliers, stale observations, and risk\-factor coverage.
* Develop, document, and enhance proxy and backfilling methodologies for illiquid, sparse, or unavailable historical time series.
* Conduct quantitative impact assessments for data\-source changes, history extensions, methodology updates, and proxy enhancements.
* Investigate material data exceptions and production issues, identify root causes, and drive remediation with Risk Analytics and Technology teams.
* Partner with Quantitative Analytics and Market Risk stakeholders on risk\-factor modelling, methodology changes, and model\-data requirements.
* Define test scenarios, execute UAT and regression testing, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for HMD platform changes.
* Contribute to automation, monitoring, and tooling enhancements that improve the scalability, transparency, and control of time\-series management.
* Prepare management information on data quality, proxy usage, backfilling activity, risk\-factor coverage, exceptions, and remediation progress.
* Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, source selection, transformations, proxy logic, controls, approvals, and implementation outcomes.
* Support governance, audit, model\-risk, and regulatory reviews relating to historical market data and market risk measurement.



  





  





 Qualifications and Experience:
 



  




* Master's degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 5\-12 years of relevant experience within Market Risk Time series, Quantitative Risk, Risk Analytics, Market Data, Product Control, or a closely related function in a bank or financial institution.
* Hands\-on experience with historical time\-series data, market\-data validation, proxy construction, backfilling, risk\-factor mapping, or data\-quality controls.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and communicate quantitative issues clearly.
* Effective stakeholder\-management skills and the ability to work across Risk, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and control functions.
* Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, validation, automation, and investigation; advanced Excel proficiency required.
* Experience working with large\-scale historical time\-series datasets and applying statistical techniques to identify gaps, outliers, and structural data issues.
* Familiarity with market\-data vendors, risk engines, or platforms such as Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv, Murex, MSCI RiskMetrics, or equivalent systems is advantageous.
* CFA, FRM, CQF, or an equivalent professional qualification is advantageous.



  





**Organization Overview:** 




  





 Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.
 



  





 MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.
 



  





 MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices. MGS Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
 Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
   

  

 Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in\-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200\+ specialties and \+12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
   

  

 We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.
   

  

 As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in\-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
   

  

**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**
* Define Insurance Policies \& Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance\-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross\-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data \& Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes \& Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance \& Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance\-related quality questions.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5\+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI\-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-
 *Together, Not Alone* 
 , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Planning & Operations
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
   

  

**Job Details**
**Position Summary**
 The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision\-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands\-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high\-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives.
   

  

 The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. The role is accountable for developing team capabilities, establishing modeling standards and best practices, and ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of modeling projects aligned with organizational priorities.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
 People Leadership \& Talent Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Supply Chain Modelers and Analysts.
* Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning activities.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and capability development of modeling resources.
* Establish technical competency standards and promote continuous learning across the team.
* Foster collaboration, innovation, and a high\-performance culture.


**Project \& Portfolio Leadership**
* Manage a portfolio of network modeling, transportation optimization, simulation, and supply chain strategy projects.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, resource availability, and organizational objectives.
* Provide project oversight, quality assurance, and governance throughout project lifecycles.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and align with stakeholder expectations.
* Present recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.


**Supply Chain Modeling \& Optimization**
* Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of end\-to\-end supply chain network models.
* Evaluate scenarios including network expansion, consolidation, facility location, inventory positioning, manufacturing footprint changes, transportation strategies, and capacity investments.
* Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth.
* Develop transportation optimization and cost\-to\-serve models.
* Support long\-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis.
* Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies.


**Stakeholder Management \& Consulting**
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for analytics\-driven decision making.
* Translate complex business problems into quantitative analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Facilitate workshops to define objectives, assumptions, constraints, and decision criteria.
* Communicate findings through executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and storytelling.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


**Process \& Capability Development**
* Establish and maintain modeling methodologies, governance processes, and best practices.
* Improve data quality, model documentation standards, and model validation procedures.
* Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.


**Work Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics \& Optimization.
* 2\+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios
* Expertise in network modeling, optimization, transportation, and operations research.
* Experience with supply chain network modeling tools, data analytics and visualization.
* Hands\-on with network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, PowerBI, Alteryx, Databricks).
* Strong knowledge of supply chain design, inventory, warehousing, and capacity planning.
* Exposure to Operations and different supply chain strategies (store, crossdock, import, buy/lease, etc)
* Experience coaching and training modelers


**Education Qualification**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or any other related discipline or equivalent related experience.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

* Network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, or similar)
* Supply chain simulation and modeling tools
* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics platforms
* Statistical analysis, optimization, and scenario planning
* Supply chain design, inventory, transportation, warehousing, and capacity planning


 Leadership Competencies
   

  

* Strategic thinking
* Influencing without authority
* Executive communication
* Coaching and talent development
* Project and portfolio management
* Change leadership
* Analytical problem\-solving


 Success Measures (KPIs)
   

  

* On\-time delivery of modeling projects
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Team engagement and capability growth
* Business value from recommendations
* Cost savings, service improvements, and capacity optimization
* Adoption of modeling tools and best practices
* Reduced analysis cycle time through automation and standardization


 Key Improvements
   

  

* Removed repetitive wording for brevity.
* Simplified KPI descriptions while retaining meaning.
* Standardized terminology and formatting for a more professional job description.
